title: Editor’s Pick: Wild Bioscience - Nature Biotechnology
gist: Nature Biotechnology names Wild Bioscience, led by CEO and co-founder Ross Hendron, as an Editor's Pick in its annual roundup of companies that raised sizeable early-stage funding the previous year. The company works on crop gene editing for higher yields and climate resilience. Most of the article is behind a login wall, so the accessible text has very little detail.

insights.claim: Each year Nature Biotechnology highlights companies that received sizeable early-stage funding in the previous year, and Wild Bioscience was selected as one of its Editor's Picks.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Being picked suggests Wild Bioscience closed a notable early-stage round, which puts it on watch lists for later-stage ag-biotech investors.
